#724 · Arrow Quill Pokémon

Decidueye

Grass Ghost

Alola · Generation 7

Decidueye is a Grass/Ghost-type Arrow Quill Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 36.6 kg. It evolves from Dartrix. Its highest base stat is Attack (107), with a base stat total of 530.
